title: Control assessment: configuration settings
source_system: Benchmark scans of 10 servers; SNMP and management service checks on 25 sampled cabinet switches; cloud guardrail export
what_it_shows: Cloud and server settings match the documented settings; 9 of 25 sampled cabinet switches used vendor-default SNMP community strings and 6 of 25 had Telnet enabled; no drift report for access elements

title: Control assessment: component inventory
source_system: OSS inventory export; physical count of 40 devices at POP-A on 2026-08-11
what_it_shows: Of 40 devices counted at POP-A, 14 were not in the OSS inventory; about 140 POP devices are tracked only in a spreadsheet; software versions are not recorded for access elements; the POP inventory has not been reviewed since the 2023 acquisition

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: NOC outage and storm plan (2025); BIA (P05); IT recovery notes; IT Director and NOC Director interviews
what_it_shows: The NOC outage and storm plan covers network service; no IT contingency plan exists for the cloud workloads, a BSS outage or SYS-18; no vendor recovery contacts in any plan; plans not updated for POP-A, POP-B and SYS-18

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: Restore test record (OSS, 2026-04); NOC failover test (2026-03); restore of one mediation file on 2026-08-13
what_it_shows: Only the OSS restore has been tested, with corrective actions after it; mediation, portal, data warehouse, hosted voice configuration and bulk network configuration restores have not been tested

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup job reports for 30 of 30 days in July 2026; vault lock settings; restore of one mediation file on 2026-08-13; administrator list
what_it_shows: Daily backups completed on 30 of 30 days; write-once retention, separate credentials and a second region confirmed; the mediation file restored

title: Control assessment: recovery and reconstitution
source_system: Recovery procedures; IT Director interview
what_it_shows: No written procedure for recovering mediation, the portal or the warehouse to a known state; no reconstitution procedure for the cloud workloads or SYS-18

title: Control assessment: identification and authentication
source_system: IdP export; TACACS+ configuration; login tests on 10 access elements and 2 SBCs; SYS-18 account list
what_it_shows: Workforce users have unique IdP accounts; shared local administrator accounts worked on the tested access elements and SBCs, and SYS-18 uses shared accounts

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: MFA sign-in tests on 25 sampled privileged accounts across IdP, cloud, servers, core routers, access elements and SBCs
what_it_shows: MFA was required on 17 of 25 sampled privileged accounts; the 8 accounts on access elements and SBCs had no MFA

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: IdP password policy; TACACS+ key records; SNMP checks on 25 cabinet switches; mediation configuration review; password change records for shared accounts
what_it_shows: IdP-managed authenticators follow the policy; default SNMP community strings on 9 of 25 sampled cabinet switches; shared element passwords and TACACS+ keys unchanged since 2022; the mediation service account secret is stored in clear text in a configuration file

title: Control assessment: customer authentication
source_system: Portal and app reset tests; chatbot configuration and test on 2026-08-11; SYS-18 business portal reset test
what_it_shows: Portal and app resets use a one-time code to the number or email of record; the chatbot fallback stayed disabled and had not been redesigned; SYS-18 reset a password with the account number and ZIP code

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: 2024 IR plan; P08 runbook drafts; incident log (10 of 41 incidents); 2025 tabletop report; MDR runbooks
what_it_shows: The 10 sampled endpoint and cloud incidents were handled with the MDR through each phase; no incident binder, no FCC reporting facility access and no network element evidence-preservation steps; 4 of 6 actions from the 2025 tabletop open; network element and CPNI incidents handled by the NOC without a set procedure, and the management plane and SYS-10 outside the handling scope

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: POL-03 draft; reporting records; interviews with 15 randomly selected staff
what_it_shows: 14 of 15 staff knew to report to the NOC or the security team at once; the 2024 plan routes CPNI breach reports to the FCC under the not-yet-effective rule text, with no USSS and FBI reporting facility step and no 7-business-day hold

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: 2024 IR plan; P08 runbook drafts (2026-08); distribution records
what_it_shows: The 2024 plan has a roadmap, structure, resources and assigned responsibility; it has no PSAP and NORS clocks during containment, no CALEA compromise reporting and no metrics, defines reportable CPNI incidents with the not-yet-effective rule text, was not distributed to the NOC, regulatory affairs or customer operations, and was not updated after the 2025-07-01 merger

title: Control assessment: nonlocal maintenance
source_system: Vendor VPN account configuration; VPN logs for July 2026 (47 vendor sessions); vendor maintenance records
what_it_shows: 47 vendor sessions in July 2026 had no approval record and were not monitored or recorded; one shared account and token for all OLT and SBC vendor engineers, with a password unchanged since 2023, reported under the stop-and-notify rule on 2026-08-12; vendor access is standing

title: Control assessment: physical access
source_system: Walkthroughs of CO-1, CO-4, CO-6, POP-A, POP-B and 4 cabinets (2026-08-10 to 2026-08-13); badge logs; key register
what_it_shows: Badge entry, logs, escorts and two-person CALEA room entry at the visited central offices; POP-B uses mechanical keys; cabinet keys are issued to crews without a sign-out record and are not inventoried; cabinet locks were not re-keyed after 2 lost keys in 2026

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: 25 of 142 terminations; badge system and SYS-18 account lists
what_it_shows: IdP access, badges and equipment were removed for the 25 sampled leavers; 2 kept SYS-18 access for 19 and 42 days; shared network element credentials known to departed engineers were not changed

title: Control assessment: CPNI approval before use
source_system: BSS approval flag report; churn model data flow; chatbot offer test 2026-07-22; campaign register
what_it_shows: Opt-out approvals are captured in the BSS; the churn model and chatbot offers use voice CPNI without reading the approval flag

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring
source_system: Scan reports (6 months); scan scope; advisory tracker; remediation records for 50 critical findings
what_it_shows: Servers and cloud are scanned monthly and results analyzed; network elements are not scanned or monitored for vulnerabilities; 2 internet edge routers took 47 and 61 days to patch critical advisories against a 30-day target

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Vendor register (34 vendors with access); contracts for the chatbot, CCaaS, overflow center and bill print vendors; P09 vendor reviews
what_it_shows: Oversight is documented for the 12 Tier 1 vendors; the chatbot and CCaaS contracts have no 24-hour incident notice and no bar on training models with CPNI or transcripts; 22 of 34 vendors with access have no ongoing oversight

title: Control assessment: unsupported components
source_system: Lifecycle register; vendor end-of-support notices
what_it_shows: TDM switches unsupported since 2024 (retirement 2028), with third-party spare parts support; 2 SBCs reach end of support 2026-12-31 with upgrades not yet scheduled

title: Control assessment: denial-of-service protection
source_system: Upstream scrubbing contracts; 2026 mitigation reports; DNS rate limits
what_it_shows: Always-on scrubbing with two providers mitigated 3 attacks in 2026; DNS rate limits configured

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Firewall rule exports (CO-1, CO-4, POP-A, POP-B, cloud hub); reachability test from a corporate VLAN at POP-A on 2026-08-12
what_it_shows: The internet edge and the cloud hub are monitored and controlled; traffic between corporate and management zones at the POPs is not monitored; from a corporate VLAN at POP-A the tester reached the SSH ports of 31 management-plane devices, including the path to SYS-10

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch reports; 50 critical vulnerability findings and their remediation dates; network element upgrade records
what_it_shows: Server and endpoint flaws are identified, tested and corrected on schedule; edge router critical flaws were corrected 17 and 31 days late; OLT and cabinet switch firmware is applied only during unrelated maintenance

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: SIEM use cases; MDR scope; simulated impossible-travel sign-in on 2026-08-12; management plane review
what_it_shows: The simulated sign-in was escalated in 12 minutes; IdP, cloud, endpoint, firewall and VPN sources are monitored; network elements, the management plane, the CDR archive and the POP management interfaces are not monitored

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments
source_system: Vendor register; P09 vendor-soc2-review.csv
what_it_shows: 12 of the 34 suppliers with access have been assessed

title: AI portfolio assessment records
source_system: Use case documentation, vendor terms and interviews with each business owner; AI-005 pilot proposal; churn model change ticket
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of each use case, its data, its users and the human review of its outputs; the competitor-call feature was removed from the churn model on 2026-08-28 (change ticket); the AI-005 proposal is an enterprise generative AI service for 120 pilot users under terms that bar training on company data
